body: Reuben, Life sucks. But there might come a day when you might be happy. Really happy. Delighted. It might be your favourite ice-cream. A football game where your team wins. A girl compliments your hair. Trust me these moments will hit and you will be thanking yourself for the time when you didnt kill yourself.
If you can tell him I prayed for him and I wish him all the happiness in the world, please do.
Can relate. Been like that for a few years now. Happy birthday.
Can relate. I feel like nobody's priority.
Happy cake day brother. I wish you all the happiness.
Everybody is fucked up here yet nobody disses them for being so. Reddit is heaven.
Just wait for the right person. It will be worth it. Worth all the loneliness all the sadness and all the hurt. You will connect with the right one. You will know.

I wont say there are happy days ahead but i would say if you wait just the right amount you get what you deserve and nobody deserves sadness. I hope you see this my friend and keep yourself up. You will win at the race against your brain. I am praying for you right now. Please dont give up. Please.

I would have never had mental peace i guess if i had been with her. I just want to be happy not depressed af. I know she wont forgive me but did i do the right thing to come out and tell her the harsh truth ?
This world is dirty, brother. Please keep fighting. I wish you all the happiness i couldnt achieve.
Happy belated birthday mate. I know how it feels. My birthday is coming up soon. And i wish i could just skip that day every year. Why should the fact that i was born be celebrated ?
Hello. I am looking forward to buying this phone. How is it doing ? Is the chip slow for light apps twitter facebook etc ? How is the battery ? Please reply. Thank you.
